svg.metadata: {"id": "s026", "name": "长城", "cat": "语文与历史", "tags": ["历史", "语文", "地理", "传统文化"], "desc": "秋日群山之上，长城沿山脊蜿蜒，烽火台点缀峰顶；近景是城墙步道与垛口、敌楼，适合历史与语文课。", "stand": {"ground_y": 950, "x": [520, 1300]}, "subtitle": [0, 950, 1920, 1060], "layers": [{"name": "sky", "enter": "fade", "delay": 0, "loop": null, "depth": null}, {"name": "clouds", "enter": "slide-l", "delay": 0.2, "loop": "drift", "depth": null}, {"name": "far_mtn", "enter": "rise", "delay": 0.2, "loop": null, "depth": null}, {"name": "far_wall", "enter": "fade", "delay": 0.35, "loop": null, "depth": null}, {"name": "mid_mtn", "enter": "rise", "delay": 0.35, "loop": null, "depth": null}, {"name": "mid_wall", "enter": "fade", "delay": 0.5, "loop": null, "depth": null}, {"name": "mist", "enter": "fade", "delay": 0.55, "loop": "drift", "depth": null}, {"name": "near_mtn", "enter": "rise", "delay": 0.45, "loop": null, "depth": null}, {"name": "parapet", "enter": "rise", "delay": 0.6, "loop": null, "depth": null}, {"name": "walkway", "enter": "rise", "delay": 0.1, "loop": null, "depth": null}, {"name": "tower", "enter": "slide-r", "delay": 0.7, "loop": null, "depth": null}, {"name": "flag", "enter": "pop", "delay": 1.0, "loop": "sway", "depth": null}, {"name": "pine", "enter": "slide-l", "delay": 0.8, "loop": "sway", "depth": null}, {"name": "birds", "enter": "slide-l", "delay": 1.1, "loop": "drift", "depth": null}], "palette": {"sky1": "#8FCBEB", "sky2": "#FBE6CF", "sun": "#FFD99A", "m1": "#C8D3E6", "m2": "#A9BCD6", "m3": "#8FB79A", "m4": "#6FA27F", "m5": "#5A8E6A", "wall": "#D9B98E", "wall2": "#BF9A6C", "wall3": "#A67F55", "brick": "#C9A574", "top": "#E8CFA6", "autumn1": "#E9824F", "autumn2": "#F2B24C", "autumn3": "#D9604A", "pine": "#3F7A5A", "pine2": "#5E9A72", "trunk": "#7A5238", "walk1": "#D7BE98", "walk2": "#C2A47A", "flag": "#D9483B"}}
